title: 3-SPEED AUTO TRANS-INSTALLATION & ADJUSTMENT
summary: Adjustment of the automatic transmission backdrive (ignition park-lock) cable between the steering column lever and the transmission lever, for M40 cars. Procedure only; no part numbers.

fastening.note: Backdrive cable (B) connects column lever (A) to transmission lever (C).

notes: 1. Put the transmission in PARK and push column lever (A) fully up against the internal PARK stop.
2. Install backdrive cable (B) to column lever (A) and trans lever (C).
Check: in PARK the ignition key must turn freely to LOCK; LOCK must not be possible in neutral or any gear other than PARK.
notes_internal: Letters A/B/C are procedure labels, not part callouts; parts are on sheet A15.
